item.title: Programa
item.description:
Qué es la asamblea de Turina xLa Pública

La asamblea de Turina xLa Pública busca integrar y organizar las luchas de los distintos sectores del instituto en una única corriente mediante la representación estudiantil, en concreto, integra a colectivos de alumnos en defensa de la educación pública y los derechos del estudiantado obrero.

Consulta este documento para conocer los estatutos, características y el programa de nuestra asamblea.

Roles y responsabilidades

Two-deep rule

Aim for at least two organizers at every event. If one person is unwell or stuck in traffic, the meetup still happens.

item.title: Huelga indefinida en educación
item.description:
Arranca la huelga indefinida en educación.

Tras meses de organización, asambleas y presiones, hemos llegado a la huelga general más preparados que nunca.

Docentes y estudiantes del Turina participan en las convocatorias, con piquetes en el centro desde las 8 am; y en los centros de educación primaria del barrio, posteriormente.

A las 12:00, nos sumamos a la concentración en Sol, junto a la acampada, que logra llenar la plaza y las calles aledañas. Finalmente, marchamos hasta la consejería y, a pesar de la fuerte presencia policial, finalizamos la concentración sin incidentes.

item.title: Code of Conduct
item.description:
The short version

Be kind. Be respectful. Assume good faith. Rocky Cove Aquarium Club is a community of people with a wide range of backgrounds and experience, and we’re here to enjoy this together. Harassment and exclusionary behaviour are never acceptable.

Expected behaviour

  • Be welcoming, friendly and patient, especially with newcomers.
  • Be considerate in your speech and actions, and respectful of differing viewpoints.
  • Assume the person you’re talking to knows things you don’t, and vice versa.
  • Give others space and time to speak; make room for quieter voices.

Unacceptable behaviour

  • Harassment, intimidation, or discrimination in any form.
  • Offensive comments related to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, race, ethnicity, religion or experience level.
  • Unwelcome sexual attention, or deliberate intimidation, stalking or following.
  • Sustained disruption of sessions or other events.
  • Photographing or recording someone without their consent.
Reporting

If you experience or witness behaviour that makes you feel unsafe, tell any organizer at the event, or email hello@example.com. Reports are taken seriously and handled with discretion, and we will always protect the privacy of the person reporting.

item.title: Get involved
item.description:
Host a session

We’re always looking for members to lead a session! No experience necessary. Whether it’s your first time or your fiftieth, we welcome you, and we’ll help you prepare, rehearse, or even co-host.

Sessions run 20–30 minutes; show & tell spots are just five. Bring anything our community would love.

Suggest a session

Offer a venue

Have a room for 20–40 people, near transit, with step-free access? You can host our next gathering. Community halls, cafés and workplaces make wonderful hosts. See the venue checklist for what we look for.

item.title: Sobre Nosotros
item.description:
Rocky Cove Aquarium Club brings together aquarium keepers of every kind, freshwater, saltwater, planted, brackish, and the ones still cycling their first tank. We meet monthly to share what we’re keeping, learn from each other, and trade the occasional bag of shrimp.

No experience necessary. Some of our favourite meetings have been carried by a member’s very first betta setup.
